params.caption: 🏆 Valorant patch 13.10 shakes up Sentinels and assists Riot's 13.10 update is live, bringing a mix of buffs and nerfs across the Sentinel agents. The patch also changes how in-game assists work, which could shift how support play is rewarded in ranked and pro matches. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 17:28 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto #Valorant #Esports #GamingNews
